notes.title: Inside TeeKru – August Update
notes.notes:
Inventory Evolution
The Syndi have been busy. Inventory's evolving, the arsenal's expanding, and Glim just got her own equip window. Stacks go up to 1000, Survival depends on what you carry.

Drag-and-drop: Smooth
Click-to-drag: Accessibility covered 
Right-click equip: Instant 
Quest items: Sacred. Safe. Breaking quests for a laugh is funny once, until you soft-lock your save.
  

[previewyoutube="RxQLI9DhhaE;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr]Video: Weapons, Loot, and Chaos 🎥
Big Hammer - flattening Concubines with concussive force.

Laser Sci-Fi Sniper - surgical pew-pew from across the map.

Arquanum Orbs - magic grenades packed with volatile destruction.

Twin Blades - strapped to the back, built for fast, relentless close combat.

Bow Combat - strafes, chained combos, and the Gattling Rain finisher no one walks away from.

Knife - lethal, fast and quiet; waiting for the perfect strike.

Admiral Glim on the HMS Draven - She has her own equip window, wears a rebreather and her Captain's cap underwater, and takes her role very seriously. Glim makes the rules.
[hr][/hr]Inventory Is Strategy and Survival, not just a Menu.
Your loot is the fuel for chaos, comedy, and questionable life choices. In A.L.A.R.M., moving items around should feel as satisfying as smashing faces with a hammer, or watching Glim run naval ops like a furry Poseidon.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527733/4859a80e8c30553f49f1ba893f7548904814dabd.jpg"]
[hr][/hr]Quip of the Month ⚓🐾
“Admiral Glim ordered a broadside of snacks from the HMS Draven. Concubines were confused. Victor cried. It was glorious.”

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527733/de67640fceeb72b2ff1e50f4c7527374cb29b9d9.jpg"]
[hr][/hr]Next Month… 👀
Inventory’s just the appetizer. September is when we start serving the main course. Sharper blades. Stranger loot. And maybe, just maybe, the kind of feature that makes you whisper, “Did they really just put that in a game?”

Stay tuned.
